profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Observability (CoreAI)
profile.summary:
Front-End Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable, intuitive
applications for global brands including Microsoft, Starbucks, and Disney. Expert in React,
TypeScript, and UI design. Adept at cross-functional collaboration, mentoring, and driving
technical excellence. Proven track record of improving performance, reducing overhead, and
standardizing design across platforms. Excited to build the next generation of AI-driven solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built React interfaces used across 10,000+ locations, improving task efficiency by 30%
- Integrated GraphQL and RESTful APIs to reduce data latency, enhancing real-time
inventory visibility
- Automated UX testing pipelines, cutting manual QA effort and improving release
confidence
- Improved scalability and reliability through Kubernetes deployments, supporting peak
loads and achieving 99.9% uptime
- Partnered with SREs and PMs to deliver dashboards for inventory and partner tools,
improving operational decision-making
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TypeScript · React.js · Redux · Node.js · Responsive design · dashboard development · User-centered Design · Microsoft Azure · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · RESTful APIs · GraphQL · Kubernetes · CI/CD · Jenkins · Cypress · Test Automation · performance optimization · Agile Methodologies · Cross-functional Collaborations · Mentoring engineers · leading technical initiatives · Code Review

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed standardized React components used across 5 Azure portals, reducing
design overhead and improving UI consistency
- Visualized agent telemetry data to uncover performance bottlenecks, contributing to a
15% improvement in system reliability
- Collaborated with backend and data teams to deliver observability features for internal
Azure AI stakeholders

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered scalable Node.js applications supporting 100+ internal cloud services,
improving uptime and resource allocation
- Led development of the Analytics Portal and Public Cloud Manager, increasing cloud
visibility and reducing resource waste by 20%
Created dashboards for internal cloud operations, improving user satisfaction
- Mentored junior engineers and drove adoption of reusable components and design
patterns

positions.title: Web Designer & Developer
positions.description:
Develop and deploy Analytics Dashboard for S4 Data Fabric Team at The Disney Company

UI components using AngularJS, AngularUI, Highcharts

Projects include: Amazon.com - Online Shopping for Electronics, Apparel, Computers, Books, DVDs, CenturyLink - Home & Business Internet, Phone, and TV, and LexBlog - Law Blogs & Legal Publishing Platform for Lawyers

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Develop and deploy web sites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Liquid Markup, PHP, and WordPress

UX design for mobile, tablet, and desktop versions of SERP pages and web portals

Perform maintenance and updates to existing websites as requested

Projects include: InfoSpace Partners, MyGCI Home, PCHFrontpage - Local and National News, Search and Daily Instant Win Opportunities!, and myTELUS - Home

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Develop and deploy content management system using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Drupal

Email marketing and landing pages for marketing campaigns

UX design for manufacturer of portable ultrasound machines 

Web Designer for a manufacturer of portable ultrasound machines

Projects include: SonoSite - Portable, Point-of-Care Ultrasound

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Web designer at an independent record label

Clients included bands My Goodness, The Royal Bear, and Revenna Woods

Develop and deploy content management system using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Joomla

Projects include: Sarathan Records - Home
